observedIssues.decision: Format the changed script and rerun the affected gate.
observedIssues.resolution: Ran ruff format on scripts/summarize_quality_gates.py; quality-fast subsequently passed.
observedIssues.followUp: Keep formatting in the per-gate quality-fast evidence and do not bypass it.

observedIssues.decision: Stop and regenerate the source-bound SBOM baseline within Work Item scope.
observedIssues.resolution: Ran check_supply_chain.py sbom --write and reran check-sbom successfully.
observedIssues.followUp: Require supply-chain baseline alignment before reporting quality completion.

observedIssues.fact: release.json.supplyChain.sbomDigest still referenced the previous SBOM after baseline regeneration.
observedIssues.decision: Update the digest binding only; do not change releaseTag, candidate version, or provider state.
observedIssues.resolution: Updated release.json to the recomputed SBOM digest and reran release evidence checks.
observedIssues.followUp: Keep release metadata digest bindings in the Work Item scope when implementation changes alter evidence.

observedIssues.fact: Candidate release-digests.json differed from recomputed artifact evidence after the SBOM change.
observedIssues.decision: Regenerate candidate release digest evidence and rerun the supply-chain gates.
observedIssues.resolution: Ran check_supply_chain.py release --write; release, SBOM, and provenance checks passed.
observedIssues.followUp: Do not reuse release evidence from before a source or artifact change.

observedIssues.fact: The five hosted performance scenarios were initially recorded only as prose/known gaps after ai-finish; an attempted custom hostedPerformanceEvidence field was then rejected because the Summary schema does not allow it.
observedIssues.decision: Stop PR handoff; remove the unsupported field and create a schema-level corrective Work Item rather than bypassing Summary validation.
observedIssues.resolution: The unsupported field remains removed from the accepted Summary shape; the five hosted scenarios remain an explicit open evidence gap.
observedIssues.followUp: Create a corrective Work Item to add a registered structured hosted-evidence schema and validator before claiming this acceptance complete.

observedIssues.fact: After the archived Summary and Archive Manifest were corrected, archive/index.json still retained the previous Summary and Manifest digests.
observedIssues.decision: Stop PR handoff until the archive index, Manifest, Contract, and Summary digests agree.
observedIssues.resolution: The index digests will be regenerated after the final Summary and Manifest edits, followed by a full archive integrity audit.
observedIssues.followUp: Make archive index regeneration and digest validation an automatic post-finish gate.

observedIssues.fact: PR #408 changed source-bound release evidence files as part of WI-21 baseline alignment, so smoke.yml entered AI_RELEASE_PREPARATION=1 and rejected the existing reserved v0.5.44 candidate before quality gates ran.
observedIssues.decision: Do not change the candidate version or publish; stop the PR and create a corrective Work Item for release-preparation scope semantics.
observedIssues.resolution: Resolved by the merged process-evidence-release-preflight-20260727 corrective Work Item; revalidation run 30280375075 treated this ordinary PR as non-release work and release-evidence completed successfully without candidate publication validation.
observedIssues.followUp: Ensure ordinary governance/evidence maintenance PRs do not run publication-candidate validation unless the Work Item explicitly declares release preparation.

observedIssues.fact: When template-smoke failed, the always-run evidence step declared template-smoke, installation-smoke, and release-evidence as required jobs but emitted only template-smoke in the jobs array; the validator then reported a misleading top-level-head binding error.
observedIssues.decision: Do not weaken evidence validation; create a corrective Work Item that records skipped/dependent jobs explicitly and reports the missing-job cause.
observedIssues.resolution: Resolved by the merged ci-evidence-terminal-aggregate-v2-20260727 corrective Work Item; run 30280375075 recorded all three required jobs and the terminal ci-evidence Job validated the aggregate successfully.
observedIssues.followUp: Add failing regression coverage for incomplete required-job evidence and precise validator diagnostics.

observedIssues.fact: Resuming WI-21 from its older work branch and rebasing onto the merged process-correction main exposed conflicts in generated status, archive index, and instruction traceability.
observedIssues.decision: Resolve by retaining the latest main process records and explicitly re-registering WI-21 archive and traceability evidence; do not force-reset or discard either Work Item.
observedIssues.resolution: Rebase conflicts were resolved with latest main as the process baseline and WI-21 archive/traceability entries restored; digest validation will run before PR revalidation.
observedIssues.followUp: Every resumed Work Item must rebase from current origin/main and run archive/index/traceability integrity checks before CI revalidation.

observedIssues.fact: Evidence edits made while resolving an interrupted rebase were overwritten when the remaining rebased commit replayed.
observedIssues.decision: Complete the rebase before editing archive evidence, then reapply and verify all digest-bound changes in a separate commit.
observedIssues.resolution: Reapplied RFE-098, hosted performance evidence, archive sequence, and digest bindings after rebase completion; verification is rerun from the final branch state.
observedIssues.followUp: Do not edit digest-bound archive files until the rebase state is clean.

observedIssues.fact: After quality gates passed in PR #408 run 30266670055, the always-run template-smoke evidence step declared installation-smoke and release-evidence as required even though those jobs were skipped for this non-release PR. It emitted only template-smoke, and the evidence validator failed the job with a missing-required-job diagnostic; the generated failureReasons also contained template-smoke:success.
observedIssues.decision: Do not merge WI-21 or weaken the validator. Stop the handoff and create a corrective Work Item that makes evidence job scope conditional and records every executed, skipped, or failed required job with an accurate conclusion.
observedIssues.resolution: Resolved by the merged ci-evidence-terminal-aggregate-v2-20260727 corrective Work Item and hosted revalidation run 30280375075; template-smoke, installation-smoke, release-evidence, and terminal ci-evidence all succeeded.
observedIssues.followUp: Separate ordinary PR quality evidence from release-preparation evidence, bind requiredJobNames to the selected workflow scope, and add a hosted-equivalent regression for a successful quality job with skipped release jobs.

observedIssues.fact: Hosted run 30280375075 succeeded, but repository quality gates took approximately 21 minutes 21 seconds and the job log exposed only per-minute heartbeats while gate subprocess output remained buffered; no timing artifact was uploaded for independent per-gate inspection.
observedIssues.decision: Accept WI-21 only as telemetry and workflow-ownership completion; do not claim material performance improvement.
observedIssues.resolution: Open for the next dedicated deep-performance Work Item, which must add run-isolated timing evidence, streaming diagnostics, failure-path artifact upload, and structural project-test optimization.
observedIssues.followUp: Use run 30280375075 as the pre-optimization hosted baseline and require at least three like-for-like hosted runs before any median or p95 improvement claim.
